articleTitle: Using Global Navigation Satellite Systems to Solve Complex Application Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, the list of uses for global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) is very wide: personal navigation, M2M, navigation of moving objects, various high-precision tasks. New nonstandard GNSS applications are also emerging.Now, in many industries, there is a "digitalization of the economy", which in practice means the automation of many production and technological processes. It is necessary to apply complex solutions: the integration of GNSS positioning in related technologies. As a result, it becomes possible to obtain accurate data on the location and condition of production and technological objects.

articleTitle: Operation Problems of the EER Transmitter with Narrowband Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: High efficiency power amplifiers, using switching modes of active elements operation and Envelope Elimination and Restoration (EER, also known as Kahn technique) "synthetic" amplification method are most preferred for use in onboard devices where the power supply is limited. When it is not possible to place a full-sized antenna, it becomes narrow-band. The operation of the EER transmitter on the narrowband antenna is accompanied with increasing out-of-band emissions. Physical description of the processes when the EER transmitter is operating on a narrow-band antenna was considered. It was shown that with a rapid change in the transmitted signal, the input impedance of the antenna may become negative. At these times, antenna sends energy back to transmitter. The performed simulation of the modulator's LPF characteristics shows the reasons for the growth of out-of-band emissions when operating on a narrow-band antenna.

articleTitle: Integral Quality Control of Service Profile of Traffic
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To ensure the quality of service traffic transmission in a communication network, it is necessary to ensure that the values of quality indicators are within the allowable range of values. One of these indicators is the traffic transmission rate specified in the configuration of the user traffic profile. Monitoring the compliance of the actual profile of the user traffic with the profile specified in the configuration ensures maintaining the quality of the transmission of user traffic by maintaining the values of the quality indicators in a given range of values.

articleTitle: On the Introduction of Digital Economics in the Transport Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article explores the concept of the software creation which could provide instruments of automation of execution of operations with financial instruments and the analysis of situations in the cryptocurrency exchanges for the purpose of receiving profit for successful operations on the stock exchange with minimal risks for the participant of financial transactions. The application of the created software in the transport industry is also explained.

articleTitle: Breakdown Effect and it’s Prevention in On-board Equipment of Satellite Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of breakdown effect, also called multiphactor, in on-board equipment of satellite communication systems is considered. This negative effect affects the reliability of onboard devices of high radiation power and hinders the development of radio-electronic equipment for space applications in general. The breakdown effect mechanism is carried out. We show the specifics of breakdown effect in strip and coaxial components of satellite electronic equipment and also discuss how to prevent a possible discharge in on-board equipment.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Hybrid Filter Bank for Processing Wideband Signals with Low-Speed ADCs
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, there is a tendency to increase the speed of information transmission by increasing used frequency band. However, when switching to broadband signals and operating under conditions of a high level of noise, a wide dynamic range is required when digitizing the received signal. To increase the dynamic range, it is proposed to use a hybrid filter bank, which allows processing the broadband signal with low-speed precision analog-to-digital converters. In this paper, was calculated and simulated a hybrid analysis-synthesis filter bank for the 26.25 MHz-86.25 MHz frequency range. Using matched filters, we estimated the distortion of a linearly frequency-modulated signal during the passage of filter banks without intermediate processing, after upsampling and downsampling intermediate signals from the outputs of analog filters. To reduce phase shifts and time delays arising during signal processing by synthesis filters, compensation delays and phase shifts were introduced, adjusted to distortions carried by the processing system. It was shown that phase correction allows reducing signal distortions. It was also shown that in the case of receiving a mixture of signal and noise, the distortion introduced by the processing system does not significantly affect the signal-to-noise ratio of the output signal.

articleTitle: Dependence of the Efficiency of the Distribution of Anti-icing Material on the Type of Suspension of the Weighing Conveyor
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the influence of the type of suspension of the universal spreader of the de-icing material installed on the mobile chassis of the combined road machine on the dosing accuracy. Since the change in environmental parameters is continuous, automated road meteorological stations are used for greater efficiency, and on the basis of these data, it is possible to quickly change the process of distribution of the deicing material by combined road machines.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Methods Applying for Hydraulic System States Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the analysis of a dataset on the states of the hydraulic system of the aircraft and an attempt to classify error in valve switching modes for further research of the possibility of predicting failure or the need to repair the valves of the system.

articleTitle: Software Optimization Methods for Composite Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The latest direction in a research of construction composite materials having the term "computer materials science" which is engaged in studying of properties of composite materials on the basis of modeling with use of computers is presented in article. The results of this work allow you to simulate materials for absorbing different types of waves that can be used in the construction of shared roads.

articleTitle: Neural Network Using to Analyze the Results of Environmental Monitoring of Water
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The acuteness of the environmental tracking problem is constantly growing. Currently, environmental issues are analyzed using big data. Many open data sources (Kaggle, Open Data Portal of the Russian Federation, etc.) contain a variety of environmental information. Based on the data and using the tools for analyzing big data and machine learning, a system has been developed that simulates the state of water quality in the Moscow waters. On the basis of the indicators obtained, the neural network was trained, which classifies the state of the reservoir into good and deviant.

articleTitle: On Some Features of Binary Code Combinations
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: When digitally displaying various messages, it is important to understand the characteristics of the generated digital sequences, to be able to evaluate the potential possibilities of such transformations. For this purpose, exact analytical expressions are derived for obtaining the number of code combinations for a given minimum code distance and the length of the code combination. Potentially achievable exact bounds for minimum code distances of 2, 3 and 4 are given.

articleTitle: Critical Infrastructure Security: Alignment of Views
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Critical infrastructures of all countries unites common cyberspace. In this space, there are many threats that can disrupt the security of critical infrastructure in one country, but also cause damage in other countries. This is a reality that makes it necessary to agree on intergovernmental national views on the composition of critical infrastructures, an assessment of their security and protection. The article presents an overview of views on critical infrastructures of the United States, the European Union, the United Kingdom, and the Russian Federation, the purpose of which is to develop common positions.

articleTitle: Experimental Results of Dispersion Distortion Compensation of Wideband Signals With a Device Based on a Digital Filter Bank
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents a theoretical and experimental study, the purpose of which is to confirm the performance and efficiency (availability in terms of the signal-to-noise ratio) of the previously developed algorithms for compensating for dispersion distortion of broadband signals in the decameter band, embedded in a digital analysis-synthesis filter bank.

articleTitle: Application of Weber-Fechner Law in Image Transmission in the Field of Onboard Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the modern world, image transmission, including transmission of television and video signals, is carried out using a preliminary and restorative correction according to the law, which was due to the use of imaging devices on cathode ray tubes. This law differs from the law of dependence of the visibility threshold of a visual stimulus on its magnitude, but continues to be used for compatibility reasons. Therefore, in the work, instead of linearizing the sensations of the quantization scale of a television signal, it is proposed to optimize the choice of code combinations for image transmission. This approach can be effective in television systems without compression of video information with losses, for example, for transmitting signals over short distances or in channels for transmitting signals of the image of Earth remote sensing systems.

articleTitle: Microwave-Photonic Sensory Tire Control System Based on FBG
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses a possibility of using fiber-optic sensors based on addressed fiber Bragg structures (AFBS) to assess tire dynamics in real operating conditions.The presented study is motivated by the fact that vehicle dynamics control systems require reliable and cost-efficient sensors for measuring forces acting in the tire contact patch. In this regard, a description of the new technology of multi-sensor measurements for continuous monitoring of tire state is presented. The experimental sensor prototypes use AFBSs with two identical ultra-narrow-band reflection spectra (2λ-FBG). Information from the sensors is implemented as input parameters of algorithms, which allow to estimate key tire-related characteristics, such as pressure in the contact patch, instantaneous angular velocity and effective wheel radius. One of advantages of this technology as compared to analogous devices is the use of an optical photodetector as an interrogator that greatly simplifies the system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Management System of the Automobile Road’s Technical and Operational Condition in the Cryolithozone
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A functional scheme of technical and operational condition (TOC) management of the automobile road located on permafrost soil is offered. An intelligent information system is used to collect information about current state of the automobile road, weather and climatic conditions, characteristics of traffic flows. It is shown that regulatory TOC’s maintenance is based on two management processes. The first process of current management is fast and low-inertia and is based on the current state of the management object. The second process of long-term management, due to the influence of the climate change, is much slower and has a high inertia; to ensure required management quality, it is necessary to carry out this process on the basis of the object’s state forecasting and to produce management actions (stabilization of the soil temperature regime) in advance, before the appearance of visible automobile road’s TOC deterioration. Predicting the condition is based on simulation modelling, which results in determining the expected settlement of thawing soil at the formation, which causes roadway’s numerous defects. The results of numerical simulation of the predicted state of the automobile road in the climatic conditions of Yakutsk and Urengoy are shown, including the case with applying measures to stabilize the soil temperature regime (use of seasonal cooling devices – SCD). It is shown that the dynamics of changes in the state of the object occurring under the influence of the climate change is described by only two path functions in the state space – without the use of SCD and in their presence. Perspective management of the object’s state resides in choosing the path function (corresponding to a certain structural characteristics of SCD) and determining the most rational time of transition to this path function. At a low intensity of climatic changes in the territory of the automobile road location, the simulation results’ sensitivity to the accuracy of the climatic parameters’ forecast increases.

articleTitle: Tire Strain Measurement System Based on Addressed FBG-Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work presents a concept of microwave-photonic sensor system (MWPSS) for real-time measurement of vehicle tire strain. The proposed MWPSS is based on the addressed fiber Bragg structures (AFBS) with two symmetrical π-phase shifts (2π-FBG). The system utilizes two similar 2π-FBGs with equal bandwidths, the same central Bragg wavelength, and unique address frequency spacing, thus realizing the microwave-photonic measurement methods and providing their address. One of the 2π-FBGs serves for strain measurement, and the second one takes into account the effects of temperature variation. Address frequency analysis of the multiplicative optical response allows to define the central Bragg frequency shift of each sensor and to correlate it with the value of the influencing physical fields (strain and temperature). These values are the input parameters for the estimation system of tire-road contact characteristics and vehicle dynamics control.

articleTitle: The Study of Probabilistic Characteristics of Cyclo-Stationary APSK-N-Signals Caused by Communication Channel with Memory
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: New properties of communication channel with intersymbol interference utilizing by APSK-N-signals are investigated. Based on estimates of the symbol error rate caused by intersymbol interference, the possibility of increasing the data transmission rate in the channel due to "transparency windows" is estimated. New properties have been identified that allow a significant increase in the efficiency of such communication channels.

articleTitle: The System of Indicators for Risk Assessment in High-Loaded Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article describes the problem of assessing the information quality risk tolerance using semantic models for high-loaded information and communication systems.

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent RFID-System for Logistics Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper is aimed at the two-stage development of an intelligent RFID system for logistics processes. Stages can be thought of as logical and physical. The logical stage is the study of the radio frequency identification standard EPC Class 1 Generation 2 [1]. This study aims to identify protocol parameters that affect the characteristics of an RFID system. This, in turn, will allow the entire RFID system to be configured to maximize performance. In turn, to the physical - research microstrip antenna. Studies of this kind are applicable to dimensional design. This will enable the antenna size to be smaller.

articleTitle: The Usage of Neural Networks for Motion Prediction of Autonomous Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of using neural networks to select the trajectory of an autonomous transport object as part of its control system is considered in this article. Environmental data from global and local sensors are used. A neural network is proposed to predict the movement of other road users to ensure the safety of the maneuver. A method for minimizing the functional characterizing the costs of movement is proposed. This allows the control system to work in true time.

articleTitle: Technique of Traffic Flow Evolution Localization for Calibration of Deterministic-Stochastic Segregation Model
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: For traffic optimization, it is necessary to know characteristics of merging and diverging maneuvers on a road element. A mathematical model developed with the purpose to study merging and diverging maneuvers is proposed. We consider an experimental study of traffic flow on a segregation section and choose parameters of a mathematical model on the base of these experiments.

articleTitle: Moving Elements of Mobile Robots Stabilization Modelling
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the solution of the problem of stabilization of the mobile elements of mobile robots in transportation of goods. A neural network with different variants of perceptron by Python, tensorflow library and its extension tflearn was created. The simulation of the process of stabilization of the position of the mobile element of the technical system in the Open AI environment by means of the gym library is carried out. Data sets for neural network training are formed, training and testing of neural network by Python and gym library are carried out. As a result of testing recommendations on the choice of neural network architecture for the development of stabilization systems of mobile objects are given.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Filter Bank for Radio Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Radio monitoring is an important part of the cognitive radio system. The article proposes an algorithm for detecting narrow-band signals as part of a group signal in real time based on digital filter banks. A computationally efficient partial reconstruction algorithm based on a digital bank of synthesis with exponential modulation is proposed. The results of the proposed algorithm using the DRM standard were obtained.

articleTitle: Network Characteristics of Blockchain Technology of on Board Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Due to the increased popularity of distributed registry technology applications on the Internet, each of which uses network resources in different ways, has different characteristics and service requirements, there are the problem of impact of this technology to the network characteristics and how does the technology affect the network. In this article, the authors introduce a definition of the term blockchain, describe the services implemented by this technology and its scope. The authors identify the main technical characteristics and their features associated with transfer of information through the network. The authors explain how does the blockchain technology work and block structure. The authors indicate basic features of the network required for guarantee quality of service during provision and transfer for different type of traffic, determine the network scheme working with blockchain transactions and the dependence of network characteristics on application parameters. Authors show different classes of traffic priority, based on the requirements and behavior of certain types of applications, allowing maximum flexibility in the transmission of user information.

articleTitle: A Narrow-Band Interference Compensation Device Based on a Digital Filter Bank for Broadband Low-Energy HF Radio Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents a device for narrowband interference compensation on the basis of a bank of digital filters for broadband low-energy HF radio links. An analytical comparison is made of the effectiveness of signal reception algorithms in the presence of narrowband interference. The algorithm of optimal reception with the normalization of the power spectral density and the algorithm of reception with the rejection of the part of the spectrum affected by interference are compared. An algorithm and a device based on a bank of digital filters are proposed, ensuring the normalization of the power spectral density in accordance with the optimal reception algorithm. The results of the simulation and field experiment on the processing of wideband signals in the presence of interference with the help of the developed program module for the normalization of the spectral power density are presented.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Telecommunication Equipment Delays in Software-Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Mathematical models of the switch and controller of software-defined networks are built, on the basis of which formulas are derived for estimating the time delays in the telecommunications equipment of these networks. The dependencies of the time delays in the switch and the controller on the main equipment parameters, which have a major effect on the delays, are also obtained. The obtained results can be used in the design of software-configured networks in the context of various informational impacts (for various input information flows) with a given level of quality of service.

articleTitle: Results of Simulation and Experimental Research of Automobile Gas Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper is dedicated to conversion of a truck diesel engine into a gas diesel engine. Different ways of diesel engine conversion for operation on natural gas were analyzed. The gas diesel working process with minimized portion of igniting diesel fuel supplied by the Common Rail system was selected as the most suitable for such an engine. Modular gas feed and electronic engine control systems were developed in MADI which may be mounted on high- and medium-speed gas diesel engines. The fuel supply system of the base diesel engine was preserved though a new algorithm of fuel injection for the gas diesel engine was developed. The systems were perfected using simulation by computer model developed in MADI and during engine tests. The gas diesel engine demonstrated good fuel efficiency and considerable decrease of NOx and CO2 emissions, though its power at low speed decreased compared to the base diesel engine. The ways to improve this drawback during the future work were proposed.

articleTitle: Pressure Oscillations as a Factor Affecting the Management of the Fuel Injection Process in the Combustion Chamber of a Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Fuel injection causes considerable oscillations of fuel pressure at the injector inlet. One of the reasons is hydraulic impact originating when closing the injector nozzle needle. Evidently, these oscillations influence the fuel supply process in case of multiple injections: the previous injections would influence on the following ones. The influence of the interval between the impulses of a double injection on the injection rate value of the second portion was investigated. The superposition of waves in case of multiple injection may result both in amplification and damping of oscillations process. It is shown that with multiple injection, the controllability of fuel supply deteriorates, therefore, either a special design study of the fuel system for multiple injection or the introduction of additional electronic correction of control pulses by the diesel control system is required. On the other hand, it is shown how multiple injection can produce a stepwise injection characteristic, which can serve as a means of reducing nitrogen oxides and noise.

articleTitle: Analysis of Digital Filter Prototype Design Methods for High-Speed Signal Processing Based on Polyphase Filter Bank
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article presents a comparison of two methods for synthesizing digital filter prototypes. The first method based on the synthesis of the filter on a lattice structure, and the second iterative method based on minimizing the quadratic form. Both methods are applying with the fulfillment of the conditions of perfect reconstruction.

articleTitle: Models of QOE ensuring for OTT services
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the main models that contribute to improving the quality of OTT services. The main parameter for quality assessment was chosenQoE-Quality of Experience. An analysis was made of a number of factors that directly affect the assessment of QoE. The second part of the article deals with models that can provide the necessary level of quality for OTT services. These models were divided into three groups: traffic-based models, application-based models, and speed-based models. The main task of the study is to find optimal solutions to ensure the quality of OTT services.

articleTitle: A Review of Scientific Research on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article provides an analysis of research and publication activity of Russian and international scientists in the field of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML). The resources of the Scopus information bases, Web of Science and Russian Science Citation Index (RSCI) were used for the analysis. AI papers on Scopus have increased 8x since 1996, but all research articles have increased 2.6x for the same time.

articleTitle: Application of Mathematical Simulation Methods for Evaluating the Websites Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The subject of this publication is to evaluate the effectiveness of the web-site. In the E-Commerce segment, this assessment is based on four indicators (metrics): the conversion metric, the time spent on the site metric, the number of refusals metric, and the number of pages viewed. For corporate sites, especially for internal websites of vehicle (high-speed trains, air buses, etc.) the conversion metric is not suitable, but all other metrics can be fully utilized. Thus, the "user's time on the site" metric, regardless of the class of the Web site, is a critical indicator of it's effectiveness. When the site created, you can estimate the time the user is on the site using special tools. But the same important task is to assess the temporal characteristics of the site before its creation, i.e. in the design process.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of the Dynamics of Operation of the Tethered High-Altitude Telecommunication Platform in the Turbulent Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper examines a task of researching the dynamics of operation of the tethered high-altitude unmanned platform in the turbulent atmosphere. It also describes the mathematical model of position of the cable equilibrium in space and describes the differential equation system, whose solution makes it possible to assess the horizontal and vertical constituent parts of a force acting to the high-altitude unmanned platform depending on the force of wind loads at various altitudes.

articleTitle: SLAM Implementation For Mobile Robots Using Physical Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An algorithm for simultaneous localization and mapping of the surrounding space (SLAM) using the Microsoft Kinect multifunctional device and the Eken H9 camera has been implemented and investigated. A comparative analysis of the use of Microsoft Kinect and lidars. Describes the process of setting up, calibrating and obtaining a 3D model of the surrounding space using Kinect. Implemented monocular SLAM for use on board an aircraft. The main parameters and problems of the resulting system are investigated. The results obtained are applied on an aircraft of the type hexacopter.

articleTitle: A Noise Immunity Estimation of the Gold Sequence Ensembles Fast Delay Acquisition Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Object of consideration - asynchronous-address systems, using code division of channels. A subject of the analysis - the quasi-orthogonal signals ensembles based on the Gold sequences providing reliable division of channels at influence of imitation interference, signal-like noises and devices of their processing. The purpose of the analysis is to optimize the structure of the Gold sequences ensemble and to estimate the noise immunity characteristics of the delay acquisition devices. The solution is based on the principles and mathematical models developed by authors: the principle of the fast conversions in Galois fields, algebraic model of representation and structure of fast delay acquisition devices for a subclass of the sequences based on the Gold sequences. This article is devoted to create of models to mapping the original Gold sequences in the aggregate of short M-sequences, searching for conditions for their joint adaptive processing, as well as evaluating the characteristics of the decision making reliability. Key features of the described method of processing are implementation of correlation reception of set of synchronized short sequences samples having identical structure with accumulation of symbols from multiple copies of short sequences received from initial Gold sequence. It is shown that the proposed mapping models, together with offered delay acquisition devices, provide a high level of device adaptation to changes in the signal structure over a wide range. The offered versions of the scheme of delay acquisition carry out reception and preprocessing of code sequences in real time that favorably distinguishes them from the known schemes, which are carrying out fast conversions by other methods. Presented results will be useful to the specialists who are engaged in design of the asynchronous-address systems using aggregate signals with large base and changeable structure for ensuring protection against influence of signal-like noises.

articleTitle: Blind Two Real Signals Separation Method Based on Third Order Cumulants
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper describes a blind two real signals separation method. Blind separation implies that there is no information about the signals except for received samples. This eliminates the presence of a systematic error in determining the stirring matrix and the restoration of the original signals. As a criterion for the separation of signals in this paper, the cumulants of the second and third orders of the output signals were reduced to zero. To test the performance of the method, mixing and separation model was created, and the efficiency of the method was tested at various power levels of the intrinsic noise in the receiving channels.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Transmission Modes and Downlink Control Information in the LTE-Advanced / 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In release 15 of the LTE-Advanced the list of used DCI formats has been significantly expanded. A further 9 formats were added to the existing 27 formats to support new use cases for existing transmission modes and to plan radio resource allocation supported by the new 5G standard with reduced transmission time intervals. To adequately use the new capabilities in the existing communication system it is necessary to perform a complete analysis of the process of selecting the transmission mode and analyzing the main indicators, on the basis of which the base station evaluates the possibility of using a specific transmission mode for the corresponding conditions in the radio channel.

articleTitle: Paradigm of Inheritance in Large-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Based on Standard ISO 14813-1:2007 Intelligent Transport Systems, it can be concluded that: ".. the purpose of this standard is to identify service groups and ITS domains within which these service groups are positioned. Service domains and ITS groups in the form in which they form taxonomic systems provide for the addition of other systems on a global scale .. ", those ITS forms a large-scale network and "... reflect the evolution of new technology-oriented developments and practical activities in the field of transport .." which implies heredity. The inheritance paradigm is based on the distributed axioms of the unity of the biosphere: fuzziness - clarity (1D and 2D) of continuous nature and is built on three clusters of inseparability. Two incompatible universal laws of nature are valid -Transformation and Conservation, for the closeness of the basis the third dogma is inevitable - Inheritance 3D.

articleTitle: Using an Ultrasonic Sensor to Monitor Position, Transfer Control Commands and Work Information
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article deals with topic of creating an ultrasonic immersion sensor for a PIKA-19 field measurement probe, and the possibility of encoding and transmitting control commands and data from the probe measuring part using this sensor. Two ultrasonic transducers AW8?40-12OA01 and AW8R40-12OA01, operating at a frequency of 40.0 ± 1.0 kHz, were used as a transmitter and receiver of ultrasonic vibrations. The principle of operation of the transducers is based on the inverse piezoelectric effect. The manufacturer of these converters is AUDIOWELL. Our article delivers scheme of the ultrasonic emitter. The formation of a package of ultrasonic pulses is organized by software under the control of an ATM-Mega-8 microcontroller. An increase in the amplitude of the output signal is provided by the MAX232 transceiver. An ultrasound receiver circuit has been developed. It includes a two-stage amplifier based on ICL7650 operational amplifiers, an LM311 comparator and a repeater based on an K1464UD1 operational amplifier. The algorithm for determining the distance between the source and receiver of ultrasonic radiation using the signal propagation time has been worked out. Two schemes of possible sensor movements are considered: approach and removal. For each scheme, a mechanism for generating control signals was tested, which trigers measurements in an external physical circuit at the moment when the specified distance between the sensors is reached. Simultaneously with the measurement of the distance between the sensors, a prototype of data transfer was carried out using an ultrasonic signal. A data coding / decoding system is proposed, which allows to eliminate the dependence of the transmitted information of the distance between the sensors. In conclusion, several steps are proposed for improving the new method.

articleTitle: The Research of the Operation of the Lithium-Iron-Phosphate Battery of an Electric Vehicle in High and Low Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to development of computer model of the traction battery of an electric vehicle. The article touches upon the issue of changing of electric vehicle battery parameters (voltage, current, capacity) as a temperature function. The model accuracy was checked experimentally by measuring the battery parameters at the different temperatures.

articleTitle: Novel Efficient Precoding Technique with Reduced Feedback for Multiuser MIMO Systems with Multiple Antenna User Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Capacity and noise immunity of wireless systems with multiple antenna technology can be increased by using new precoding techniques. The main goal of this article is to present new efficient nonlinear ordered precoding technique with reduced feedback channel for wireless systems with multiple antenna base station (BS) and user equipment (UE).Proposed precoding technique provides to increase average capacity of user channel and decrease required capacity of feedback channel.

articleTitle: Challenges for Russian Ecosystem of Higher Education for On Board Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The importance of challenges has been recognized by certain part of education professionals in Russia in the last 25 years. But only few years ago the structural shaping the management of professionalization for on board communications in line with the global trends had been commenced. The new social and economic environment demands a drastic change in the teaching process, introducing new standards and approaches for the quality measuring criteria to be introduced to meet the requirements of effective activity and demands of on board communications' employers. This is why the working out and introducing the vocational standards has become the basic instrument to adjust the employers' demands and opportunities of high education Institute (HEI). This mainstream direction of activity is considered to be a priority and basic line for the state program documents defining the guideline policy for science and education development. The concept of modernizing the vocational education should cover mechanisms for the realization of social functions, educational institutions, taking into account the global, federal and regional external trends. In compliance with these priorities we believe it is necessary to focus on the following aspects: (a) factors of social and professional background; (b) system factors; (c) principles of professional education's modernization; (d) methods of professional education's modernization; (e) the potential risks.

Author Keywords: governance of professional and intellectual potential

articleTitle: Fiber-Оptic Vibration Sensor «VIB-A»
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper describes the formulation of the problem of measuring the vibration parameters and the implementation of a single-channel fiber-optic vibration sensor based on two fiber Bragg gratings. The probe device consists of a broadband laser source, a photodetector, and a computer sound card used as an ADC.

articleTitle: Infocommunication Measurements for Model Validation of the Follow-the-Leader Model
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the paper we discuss the prospects for using modern info-communication tools to validate models of the traffic flows theory. These methods give us possibility to capture device experimental car data not only in the passive mode (from stationary cameras), but also in the active mode, i.e. inside traffic flow. We develop research on experiment with acquisition of track data from devices moving sequentially at cars within a flow in the same lane. The tracks separation procedure into homogeneous parts showed that the measurement error can be approximated by polynomial functions depending on the section type. Characterized functions can be used for traffic model validation.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of the Radio Channel Altimeter for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: It is proposed to use the radio pulse method to measure the altitude of the flight of unmanned aerial vehicles. The requirements for the energy potential of the pulsed radio altimeter of an unmanned aerial vehicle are determined. The possible loss of energy potential in measuring height is indicated. The attenuation of the pulsed signal received by the altimeter is caused by losses in the reflection of the signal from the earth's surface and due to the interference of signal fading. Interference signal fading depends from the size of the reflection area of the altimeter radio pulses. It is shown that as a result of numerous reflections of a radio signal from the earth's surface, interference fading of the signal occurs. It is proposed to describe interference fading by a four-parameter probability distribution law. The particular cases of the four-parameter probability distribution are given. A mathematical model for a radio channel for a radio pulse altimeter for unmanned aerial vehicles has been developed.

articleTitle: Synchronization Algorithm for a Satellite Communication Signals Demodulator in High Carrier Shift Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper discusses radio interfaces in satellite communications with phase types of modulation and framed signal structure. It outlines several different frequency-time synchronization algorithms of demodulator, specifies the features and conditions for their use. As a result it describes combined synchronization algorithm, which is able to work effectively in conditions of high and variable carrier frequency shift values.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of Network Traffic of Mobile Devices with Android OS
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: As part of the study of mobile device traffic, the formation of an experimental database of network traffic of selected mobile applications, which can be used for training and testing classifiers using machine learning methods, occupies an important place. To automate the process of studying mobile application traffic classification algorithms, a software package has been developed that allows you to automatically collect network traffic packets from mobile devices and save them to a database; group network traffic packets into streams; upon user request, generate data sets with specified characteristics (number of specific application flows: background traffic; generate a data set based on the already created set with the addition of new flows, excluding repetitions). To collect traffic from mobile devices running the Android operating system, an application was developed that uses the application programming interface to create virtual private networks, collects network traffic packets, identifies the source application and sends them via HTTP to server software. Using the client and server software, the database created was filled with traffic from 18 main applications. During the data collection, 71,667 streams and 6,989,991 packets were received.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Informative Features for Recognition of the Type of Pulse Repetition Interval Modulation of Signals from Radars
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The modern development of radio and radar facilities leads to the need to create special radio monitoring tools to monitor the electromagnetic spectrum. In the process of radio monitoring there is a need to detect and identify (recognition) of radio sources, in particular radars. The peculiarity of pulse radars is that the emitted radar signals can have both intra-pulse and inter-pulse modulation. There are quite a number of methods for recognizing types of pulse modulation (based on artificial neural networks, logical rules base, wavelet analysis, histogram analysis). Each of these methods uses its own set of features for recognition, which are certain parameters of the registered signal or the results of their special transformations. The effectiveness of recognition methods directly depends on the set of selected recognition features. The aim of the study is to select a dictionary of informative features for recognition of the following types of pulse repetition interval modulation (PRI) signals of radar: constant, stagger, sliding, dwell&switch, jittered, sin. To achieve this goal, two approaches were used: the choice of informative features using decision trees and the synthesis of informative features using an auto-associative neural network with a narrow throat. These approaches work well at the decision of tasks of recognition of radio signals. As a basic set of recognition features, statistical features of the distribution of the values of the pulse intervals of the radar signal proposed in [13], [14] were used: J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>. The analysis of different approaches to the selection of informative features showed that the mathematical apparatus of decision trees provides a better result compared to auto-associative neural networks. It is advisable to use features J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> to recognize PRI modulation. At the same time, auto-associative neural networks allow to minimize the feature space without significant deterioration of its separating properties. Due to the reduction of the characteristic space at the stage of pre-processing of radio monitoring data, it is possible to reduce the computing power at the stages of identification of radio sources.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Accuracy And Dynamic Characteristics of Navigate Radio Electronic Equipment with Phase and Frequency Auto Surveying in Intensive Inferences
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To modern radio-electronic devices and systems for various purposes high demands are placed on the quality of operation. In particular, this applies to electronic equipment, used as a means of radio engineering support for the normal functioning of complex technical objects, the deviation from the normal mode of which is associated with increased danger. Such means include, in particular, the means of ensuring the flights of aircraft.

articleTitle: Modeling and Self-Similarity Analysis of Non-Poissonian Traffic Represented by Multimodal Non-Typical Pascal and Rice Distributions
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern stage of development of information and communication networks requires solving of crucial tasks of network traffic statistical analysis and traffic simulation modeling. The predominance of non-Poisson traffic leads to the impossibility of analyzing multichannel communication systems by the methods of queuing theory that used to describe telephone networks. The last decade has paid much attention to research on traffic that has signs of self-similarity. The main purpose of this work is a statistical analysis of non-Poissonian traffic, represented by multimodal non-standard Pascal (negative binomial) and Rice distributions. As a result, a study of the self-similarity degree has been performed by the R/S analysis and the aggregation method. In addition, we propose to use EM-algorithm with an algorithm for determining an optimal number of clusters for an approximation of non-typical multimodal distributions.

articleTitle: Informational Aspects of Automated Monitoring of Dangerous Driving
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article focuses on the development of an intelligent system of detecting dangerous driving. The paper discusses the methods of designing client-server architecture for solving problems in transport. The developed system allows you to monitor the parameters of the movement of vehicles, and to identify the mode of dangerous movement. The introduction of the system will allow to analyze the nature of the movement of cars, and draw conclusions about the likelihood of getting into an emergency situation.

articleTitle: Spectral Efficiency of Fiber – Optic Systems Modifying Conception Advance
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Spectral efficiency of the optical fiber within the cable construction signal transmission is being analyzed. Spectral efficiency modifying variety formed by bit/baud rate and frequency/wavelength spectrum bandwidth pairwise combining are being expanded to spatial multiplexing. Spatial - spectral efficiency category and parameter are proposed. Baud-wavelength efficiency parameter implementation is being discussed. Analytic equations are derived for signal transmission rate calculations using spectral efficiency parameter as input data. Signal transmission rate calculation examples are presented.

articleTitle: Interactive Built Space as the New Means of Telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Interactive built environment is a new trend in telecommunications, based on communication of user and the space, the ability of the space to respond in real time and to accommodate different and changing needs of the users in a more effective way, creating continuous relationship between the society and the built environment. Interactive built environment is now able to receive and process information and perform actions according to the situation, therefore acting as a member of society, communicating with users.

articleTitle: Circuit Analysis, Synthesis and Simulation of Radio Devices in Electra CAD
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Analysis of the characteristics of the circuit design of radio engineering devices showed the features of the process and the specificity of the sequence and methods of its decisions, especially in the initial design stages. It cannot be reduced to composing equations and finding their solutions; it cannot be reduced only to calculation by formulas too. Therefore, the solution of the problem of circuit design of the radio engineering devices is associated with the need to develop heuristic methods based on expert systems. In addition, it is necessary to programmatically implement a CAD system that can accumulate knowledge in the field of design and act as a co-designer in the process of end-to-end automated design of the radio engineering devices. All this led to the need to implement a CAD Electra, which can be used in circuit design, including educational purposes.

articleTitle: Information Technology in The Mobile Application of Analysis and Correction of The Diet of Individual Healthy Nutrition
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article deals with the problem of developing and implementing a mobile software product for compiling a healthy human nutrition ration using IT technologies. An analysis of existing software applications in this area for desktops; developed functional requirements for a mobile computer system for healthy nutrition, formulated the conceptual foundations of information technology, formalized the general decision-making support algorithm in the preparation and optimization of a healthy diet.

articleTitle: Researches the Influence of Bends in Optical Fibers of Various Kinds on the Brillouin Traces
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Results of experimental tests of bend effect of various optical fibers on Brillouin traces are proposed. The diagnostic problems of the unauthorized access to fiber optical communication lines are demonstrated. Results of tests are proved the merit of the Brillouin reflectometry method for early diagnostics of "trouble" segments in optical cables.

articleTitle: Matrix Beam Method and Some its Applications in Radio Electronics
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The authors' modification of the matrix bean method is developed and the complete description, as far as possible, of its algorithm features. Examples of method application are given typical for the circuit theory and radio electronics in time and operator domains. In particular, the approximation of some Bessel functions is examined with an accuracy of order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>...10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> in the interval (0, 100) by the exponential polynomial of the 92<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order; the order reduction up to five times of the transient characteristics of the multi-stage amplifier on the single tuned at the same frequency circuits with accuracy ∝ 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>; the order reduction from seventh to third of the transient function of FET of the microwave range with an accuracy to units of percent's. The other possible areas of method application are considered.

Author Keywords: algorithm of the matrix beam method

articleTitle: Assessment of the Location Determining Accuracy of the Drone in Difficult Conditions of Radio Visibility
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The position accuracy of a subscriber by means of satellite navigation systems is studied in detail. However, little attention is paid to these issues in conditions of poor visibility of a navigation receiver. The article presents experimental results of the receiver localization by the GPS-GLONASS satellite constellation in conditions of considerable multipathing. The measurements were taken with a specially made experimental GPS-GLONASS receiver. These results have been analyzed using statistical methods. Such analysis permits exploring the influence of quantity and relative position of the satellites on the positional accuracy. The study justifies stricter requirements to the indices of the geometric dilution of precision, when selecting satellites in case of reduced visibility of the receiver.

articleTitle: Model of Functioning of Information System for Institute of Distance Education of Specialists of Onboard Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern education is the integration of content and learning technologies. Distance learning is an opportunity to study individually, regardless of the place and time, the opportunity to learn all my life. In all countries of the world there is an increase in the number of students remotely, the number of universities using them in the educational process is growing; a large number of international educational structures are being created, etc. currently, fundamentally new priorities are being identified in the educational sphere, the most important of which are the informatization of the management activities of educational organizations.The relevance of the topic is due to the fact that the problem of development and implementation of distance learning (DL) in higher education is particularly acute for the domestic education system due to the increasing requirements for the quality, volume and pace of the educational process and dissatisfaction with the existing system of higher education. The choice of this topic is primarily due to the interest in modern educational technologies and new systems approaches in this area, the priority of which is currently DL.

articleTitle: About Radiation Resistance of Optical Cables and Fibers
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The issue of providing the Russian market with high-quality radiation-resistant optical cables and own-made fibers arose, due to the total import substitution. Until recently, Russian optical cables, resistant to ionizing radiation, were based solely on imported optical fiber, but the long-term experience of Russian scientists, obtained during research and development work on the manufacture of laboratory samples and conducting relevant experiments, made it possible to master the mass production of specialized optical fibers, in their characteristics are not inferior to foreign analogues. When conducting one of such works, during tests of optical fiber, the dependences of radiation induced attenuation on the intensity of irradiation were found, which have not been mentioned in the literature before. For cable sheaths made on the basis of the developed fibers, materials were chosen as the experiment subjected to static gamma radiation, and which showed their suitability for operation under conditions of exposure to ionizing radiation.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the Perceptionally Linear Color Space Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, there is no color model that exactly matches the color perception of a person. It would be desirable for automatic processing of sensor data. The experiment was conducted to create such a model. The test samples specifications are defined in the article, taking into account the known parameters and characteristics of the visual analyzer. The experiment results are statistically processed using machine learning methods. Perceptional visibility saturation and hue thresholds in for given brightness, saturation, and hue values are calculated and represented as ellipses in the luminance plane. For the indicated ellipses, isocontrast space in equal brightness slices is calculated by processing the parameters of the ellipses obtained.

articleTitle: Optical Vector Analyzer Based on Double-Side Modulation With a Suppressed Carrier and Phase-Shift FBG
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A new approach to an optical vector analyzer (OVA) realization based on optical double-side modulation (ODSB) with a suppressed carrier and formation of a reference frequency, different from it, in a fiber Bragg grating with a phase shift is considered. ODSB has a higher bandwidth, allows to scan an optical device in wider frequency range on the same element base of lithium niobate, if compared to the optical single-sideband modulation (OSSB). The method is easy to implement and effective in both energy and spectrum use. The proposed OVA realization is distinguished by an extended range and high resolution of measurements, which is shown both theoretically and experimentally. The solutions to take into account the influence of the position of the PS-FBG transparency notch on the measurement accuracy based on the method of its polyharmonic sensing, which can be used for implementation in other OVA based on ODSB were proposed.

Author Keywords: double-side modulation with a suppressed carrier
fiber Bragg grating with a phase shift
amplitude and phase responses of optical devices

articleTitle: Intelligent Vehicle Condition Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This research work is devoted to the design and development of the server part of the intelligent data collection system. The advantage of such a system is that there are no analogues on the Russian market, although it can be used today. Today, this topic is more than relevant due to the emergence of a larger number of cars on the roads of our country, an increase in the statistics of road traffic accidents for 2018 compared with 2017.

articleTitle: Economic Security Assessment of Onboard Equipment Production with Possible Realization in Standard Machine Learning Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An economic security of production of the onboard equipment as autonomous objects is considered on a process basis. The interrelation of factors acting on objects and triggering processes in them, which lead to a change in their properties, is taken into account. A mathematical method and a criterion for economic security assessment of economic operations and industry systems with the possibility of their implementation in machine learning technologies are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave Diplexers Based on Two- and Three-Resonators Microstrip Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this work, we investigated the possibility of diplexers` development based on two- and three-resonator microstrip structures implemented on a substrate with a high relative dielectric constant ε<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>=80 and without short-circuited elements, which determines their high manufacturability. The conditions for the forming of at least two working attenuation poles of the microstrip structures in the frequency regions of adjacent channels are determined. It is shown that the crosstalk attenuation with such a limited number of resonators in each channel filters reaches a level of at least 55 dB.

Author Keywords: the electrical and magnetic couplin; "casting" of working attenuation poles

articleTitle: Direct Digital Synthesizers of Complex Broadband Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Principles of design and structural-schematic schemes of direct digital synthesizers, based on the direct digital frequency and signal synthesis method are presented. The block diagrams of direct digital synthesizers based on digital code accumulators and with an M-shaped frequency variation law are given. DDS allow synthesizing signals with amplitude, frequency and phase modulation in the frequency range from 0.001 to 400 MHz.

articleTitle: Implementation of the Invention "Method of Cellular Systems" : Time advance calculation
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The invention "Method of cellular systems" proposes alternative method for time advance calculation in cellular systems. The invention uses satellite positioning system for distance calculation between mobile and base stations. In the report, we will focus on the following questions: what systems benefit the most due to the invention; what actions/changes need to be held, in order to implement the invention into current/future radio communication systems; how often the mobile terminal positioning is required.

Author Keywords: calculation of distance between mobile and base stations

articleTitle: Bandwidth Optimization of Burundi Transport Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: With the constant growing demand of the society for information exchange the need for a rapid and significant optimization and modernization of optical transport networks increases. This paper aims to assess the potential capacity of the existing backbone network of the Republic of Burundi with the implementation of wave division multiplexing technology (WDM). For this purpose, the maximum length of the amplification and regeneration sections is calculated to determine the possibility of expanding the backbone network capacity without requirement to install inline amplifiers and dispersion compensation modules.

articleTitle: Voice Authentication System for Cloud Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Voice authentication is very perspective technology. It doesn't need any special biometrical devices, like finger scanner or face detector. It can be use in any place and in any channels. Our algorithm can help to recognize person by special digital voice portrait. It can be use in direct stream and in real time. It can also use in On-Board telecommunication components.

articleTitle: An Interdisciplinary Approach to Recording the State of Redundancy of the Source in Dentistry for Rheumatoid Diseases
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An information approach based on the concept of source redundancy is used to create a mathematical model with the goal of formalizing the state of a person's body or part of it, which facilitates signal generation. The possibility of digital processing of content with formalized transformation is shown. We can provide more than fifteen years of experience in on-board highly skilled dental care for children suffering from rheumatic diseases instead of emergency solutions. The primary algorithm was formed dental examination for these children with the opportunity to adopt an interdisciplinary communication of various specialists when installing diagnosis and treatment, especially at distant moving objects.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of Nonlinear Effects in Optical Systems Using Spectral Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The influence of nonlinear effects in fiber-optic transmission lines in the dispersion control mode was studied, on the basis of which methods for calculating the performance indicators optical information transmission systems and algorithms for determining parameters single-mode optical fibers were proposed. Analytical expressions are obtained, allowing to evaluate the efficiency of the functioning optical signal transmission systems based on the technology spectral and dense spectral channel compression on the wavelength.

articleTitle: Features of Bus Connection Scheme of Medium Speed IP-Devices with PoE-Option
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Expediency of the use of bus-organized structures at communication link physical layer of medium speed local area networks is substantiated. Presumption of application of Fast Ethernet devices as well as PoE+ Remote Power Feeding systems establishes the maximal number of separate segments in similar structures; and it stipulates main factors of limitation of their quantity. With deployment of a multicriterial approach, the construction of the line cable for forming up the transmission channel in terms of quantity of pairs, core class and wire diameter within classical round insulation, is substantiated.

articleTitle: Simulation of Resonator Slow-Wave Structures and Terminal Devices of TWT Sections in SHF and UHF Ranges
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the models of the rectangular and axially-symmetric slow-wave structures (SWSs) are considered. These models are used to calculate the dynamic transient response of SWSs. In order to calculate the traveling-wave tube (TWT) section parameters, the waveguide-resonator model and the regression models are utilized. The section terminal devices are simulated by the characteristic impedance of semi0infinite chain of coupled cavities. The developed models serve as the basis of the program complex "VEGA" development.

articleTitle: Determination of the Optimal Number of Parking Spaces Based on the Formulation and Solution of the Optimization Problem of the Transport Demand Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article defines the principles of the formation of parking policies in the cities. The classification of parking lots of various types and purposes is provided. An algorithm is described for determining the number of parking spaces in the system of the street-road network based on the solution of the optimization problem of the distribution of transport demand. The calculation of the required number of parking spaces on the example of the city of Perm in the Russian Federation is given.

articleTitle: Method of Adaptive Information Resources Control in the Automated Control System in Conditions of Performance Loss
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This work is devoted to the study of issues of improving information systems efficiency by utilization of certain procedures for managing of information resources distribution. The problem of distribution of applications for information provision in information subsystems of automated control systems in various functioning conditions are considered. This paper reveals the main provisions of the method of adaptive information resources control in the automated control system with loss of performance in network infrastructure nodes.

articleTitle: Network Quality Operation Prediction Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article proposes a solution to the problem of predicting the quality of a computer network using a popular machine learning method - a decision tree. Considered a real case of quality problems in the network when the web server is running. Based on the analysis of traffic recorded during the operation of the network, when problems were observed in it, a decision tree was constructed. Using the obtained model, numerical experiments were carried out to predict the moments when users have problems opening web pages. The results of assessing the quality of the prediction model obtained are given.

articleTitle: On Metods of Graphic Object Recognition Based on DTW Metric
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: We consider the possibility of using the DTW metric for shape recognition of graphic objects with incomplete group of affine transformations, including shift, scaling and rotation. A DTW-based algorithm is proposed that allows the identification of the object shape invariant with respect to such affine transformations. The statistical studies carried out show that the value of DTW metric under distortions is directly proportional to the distortion magnitude. The modeling shows that in the case of identifying the objects that do not belong to the sample class the variance of DTW metric values is significantly greater than the one observed in the case of comparing the distorted objects of the same class. This fact allows assigning a definite value of classification tolerance for each class of figures providing the required probability of false recognition and missing of objects.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Cramer-Rao Bound for Radio Direction-Finding on the Azimuth of Planar Antenna Arrays of the Non-Symmetric Form
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper deals with planar antenna arrays, such as circular, octagonal, hexagonal and rectangular, for the task of direction-finding on azimuth and elevation angles. The boundaries of the Cramer-Rao are calculated for different situations, including the location of signals in azimuth and elevation planes, and signal-to-noise ratios. Each antenna array consists of the same number of omni-directional antenna elements equal to 24, the distance between which is half the wavelength. In addition, the expressions for the steering vectors of two types of asymmetric antenna arrays, i.e. arcuate and L-shaped are given. Their influence on the direction-of-arrival estimation accuracy is considered, and the exact expressions of the Cramer-Rao boundary are given. It is established that the best geometry is arc-shaped.

articleTitle: The Rational Checks Amount Selection for the Information Management Systems Troubleshooting
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The questions of creating a rational set of controlled parameters of the information management system in order to maintain it ready to perform tasks for functional purposes. The main attention is paid to the study of the range of changes in the parameter and its impact on the performance of individual devices and the system as a whole.

articleTitle: Investigation of Catastrophe Parameters, Describing Structurally-Stable Focusings of Primary and Secondary Edge Waves by Local Asymptotic Method
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To describe the diffraction focusings of electromagnetic fields in the case when the family of primary (geometrical-optical) and secondary (edge) rays form a focusing of the cuspoid type, a method of local asymptotics has been developed. Expressions for the unfolding coefficients, the functional modulus, and the traveling wave phase are obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of Speed Disturbances in Empirical Single Vehicle Probe Data before Traffic Breakdown
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In single vehicle probe data measured on German freeways we have revealed phase transitions from free flow to synchronized flow and back to free flow that occur before traffic breakdown at a bottleneck occurs. Thus resulting in the formation of a congested pattern. Empirical findings of these phase transitions confirm a microscopic stochastic theory of traffic breakdown developed by Kerner. Only because of the recently introduced possibility of gathering larger amounts of anonymized vehicle data - including a sequence of positions of each car - we were able to show the phenomenon of these phase transitions in measured floating car data. This contribution reveals empirical findings in microscopic data which support and prove some of the recent theoretical findings of the nature of traffic breakdown.

articleTitle: Reversible Non-Distorting Compression of the Dynamic Range of the Audio Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problems of sound signal transmission and storage are considered. It is shown that the existing systems do not provide signal transmission with natural dynamic range. The algorithms used to compress and restore the audio signal lead to distortions and increase the signal-to-noise ratio only relative to the noise in the pause. An algorithm that ensures the preservation of the signal shape and increases the signal-to-noise ratio in the pause and on the signal background is considered. The results of objective measurements confirming the efficiency of the algorithm are presented.
