articleTitle: Tunable Microwave Filter as Part of the SDR System
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The concept of software-defined radio (SDR) has important advantages over traditional radio systems and is successfully used in many areas of the information infrastructure. Unfortunately, not all components of modern communication systems allow the user to change their parameters programmatically with the same efficiency. In particular, we are talking about microwave filters - important elements of the input circuits that determine the sensitivity and selectivity of radio receivers. The use of narrow-band tunable filters will reduce the influence of neighboring channels, possible interference on the useful signal, increase the communication range of the UAV with ground systems. This article is devoted to the study of the possibility of software restructuring of microwave filters on spiral resonators.

articleTitle: Modeling for DWDM System Parameters Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: New On-Board systems using Big Data volume. For Big Data transmission it is useful WDM technology. Upon transition to new generation telecommunication networks it is important to have management and supervision for all network levels. It is very important to know future monitoring system characters. In this article we use imitation modeling for WDM parameters monitoring and IP over WDM signal transferring.

articleTitle: The Physical Channels Alternative Constructions for Wireless Systems and Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A variant of code-time-division multiple access is considered. The emitted radio signal is a structured relatively short code constructions that performing a direct extension of the carrier frequency spectrum, immediately consecutive and modulating it. Herewith, the uniform amplitude envelope (modulus of the complex envelope) of the resultant group signal emitted into the radio channel is retained, if the influence of low-pass filters that limit out-of-band emissions is not included. The structure of the codes allows to implement modulation methods of the carrier frequency, similar to QAM, but more efficient. All structures include fragments of arbitrarily long code that couple them and is designed for solving a wide range of tasks related to the temporal structuring of the communication channel, synchronization, processing of multipath signals in the Rake-receiver, positioning, etc.

articleTitle: Effect of Deviation from Standard Test Procedure for Evaluartion Optical Fibres Compatibility with Filling Compounds
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Optical fibre primary coating may be exposed to hydrophobic waterblocking gels (filling compounds) during their lifetime. It is necessary to carry out tests to verify the compatibility of the primary coatings with waterblocking gels. The paper focuses on the fact that each stage of the test is important for obtaining reliable results. One of these important steps is the procedure for cleaning samples from filling compound after their exposure in the gel at elevated temperature.

articleTitle: 5G Distributed Timing Topology Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: New generation networks deploeyment has one of the perspective directions the concept of the Internet of Everything (IoE -) [3]. Rendering services in the IoE networks requires providing a stable time scale with an accuracy of definition not less than 1 ms, and at operation of applications of the tactile Internet not less than 1 microsec. As in the current legislation are absent obligatory requirements to the accuracy of definition of time in the IoE networks, the mechanism of additional certification is required. Additional certification of production and services is the mechanism for check of correctness of the made decisions and current state of projects on production of new hi-tech production and services. Existence of the certificate of Digital Innovations system can be criterion of providing a level of quality and necessary amount of works by results of the project.

articleTitle: The Study of the Mandelstam - Brillouin Scattering in Erbium Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The features of the Mandelstam-Brillouin scattering in various kinds of erbium-doped optical fibers are considered. The relationship between the frequency properties of the Mandelstam - Brillouin scattering, the Brillouin frequency shift, the distribution of the backscattered signal and the structure of the optical fiber core is analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Optical Cables Operability in a Given Temperature Range
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Requirements for the temperature range, alongside with the requirements for resistance to external mechanical stresses, are imposed on all optical cables (OC), destined for outdoor use. The calculation and methodical base that would ensure at the engineering stage required temperature ranges of any OC design admitting the use of different elements in various combinations is not presented in the literature.

articleTitle: Investigation of Hardware Impairments Degree Influence on the Reception Quality in Respect of the Zero-IF Receivers
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In addition to the analytical approach of analyzing the analog quadrature conversion imperfections effect on the signal reception quality changing, computer simulation methods are often used in the study of complex type signals. This approach allows obtaining a visual estimation of noise immunity for real signals under the I / Q-imbalance, DC offset and phase noise influence. Quantitative evaluation of amplitude-phase imbalance and DC-offset influence level on the sensitivity decreasing and reception quality degradation has been made in the article by means of simulation. The phase noise attendance is also taking into account. Studies were carried out for M-QAM signals having indices 4 ... 256 (M-QAM). This is related to the fact of them widespread using in modern mobile, satellite and digital television systems. The researches allow defining the cases in which I/Q-imbalance and DC offset compensation is mandatory required and in which it is sufficient to use modern methods of signal coding.

articleTitle: Expansion of Radical Political Ideas in Digital Society
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Technological progress leads to the transformation of social environment, generating a digital society that exists in the context of new opportunities and new threats. The article is devoted to the problem of expansion of radical political ideas among the most active in the Internet space audience of young people (18-30 years). It is considered the features of digital communication channels, the main advantages of the Internet as a "space of freedom", characteristics of the political behavior of young people in digital society. Considering the new technological conditions, as well as the peculiarities of the perception of information by the youth audience, we can talk about favorable conditions for the expansion of radical political ideas among the most active users of the "digital reality". The main threats today are cybercrime, illegal trafficking in drugs and weapons, as well as the deliberate reduction of the authority of authorities at different levels, the promotion of terrorism. So, namely the youth audience is the most important target group exposed to the information impact during the hybrid wars, which is a new type of conflicts, characterized the digital epoch. It is proposed the measures to counter the expansion of radical political ideas among young people.

articleTitle: Aggregation of Short Message Traffic in Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To transfer short message traffic on the basis of both wired and optical communication systems, from the content provider to the client, an SMS message aggregator is required. This aggregator works accordingly to certain scenarios, which are defined in control systems and have components, based on which, besides control and load balancing, the aggregator itself is scaled.

articleTitle: Impact on Window Efficiency Optical Fiber Length Changes in the Dispersion Under the Action of Negative Influences
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: the performance window of single-mode optical fibers in the VSP-SR system is Considered based on the results of its influence on the dispersion length with an increase in the number of channels, transmission speed, modulation methods, chromatic and polarization mode dispersions, nonlinear effects, changes in the power and signal-to-noise ratio. It is shown that if you do not take appropriate measures to protect against negative impacts, the transmission characteristics will change significantly and information loss may occur. These changes will affect the dispersion length.

articleTitle: Method of a Heurisistic-Combined Solution of Labor-Conductive Tasks in Parallel Computational Systems of Real Time
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A method for solving time-consuming tasks on parallel computing systems based on a combination of heuristic algorithms is described. An algorithm of polynomial complexity has been proposed and investigated, which in real time determines a rational combination of heuristic algorithms for solving the problem and the order of assigning these algorithms to the elements of a parallel computing system.

articleTitle: Modeling for Environmental Pollution Parameters Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modeling for Monitoring environmental parameters using a computer information measuring system are proposed. For this system it is very important to have imitation model. This model can shown all features of the future design system. Studies of the impurity concentration in the aqueous medium by a direct method using ion-selective electrodes have been carried out. The verification of the correctness of the results was done by the method of additives, that is, by measuring the known concentration of the component against the background of an unknown part of it in the test solution.

articleTitle: Communication Disturbances In Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern moving objects like motor vehicle, train, ship, plane and others are equipped by large quantity of apparatus and electronic devices, that are exposed to influences of external electromagnetic fields and that are existed in environment. The powerful source of electromagnetic field near earth surface and inside moving objects are lightning strokes. Its field can induce sizeable interferences in lines, circuits, devices of control and driving.

articleTitle: Stripline Microwave Filters with Increased Frequency Selectivity Based on Counter-Comb Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper investigates the design specifics of compact highly selective stripline filters based on counter-comb structures with a limited number of resonators. The selective properties of basic two-resonators counter-comb strip structures are examined. It is shown that in such structures it is possible to form a significant number of working attenuation poles at finite frequencies. The possibilities to use these structures for creating four-resonator stripline filters with additional galvanic connection between adjacent resonators, that have increased frequency selectivity without creating electromagnetic coupling between non-adjacent resonators, are shown.

articleTitle: Approach of Nanoelement Impedance Matching and its Application
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The rapid development of radio data transmission systems (RDTS) is associated with the annual exponential growth in the number of active users and the amount of information transmitted via existing communication channels. The result of this process is the significant complication of the signal-interference environment in which modern RDTS operate. The most advisible approach that allows us to create the RDTS, which function in the conditions of strong ISI caused by channel with memory, in the absence of their compensation, is the appropriate choice of the symbol duration time with regard to the resolution time of communication channel . This takes ISI into account that allows us to receive and process signals correctly in dynamic mode instead of distortion suppression. However, as shown in this work, it requires utilizing a new element base. It is highly recommended base on nanoelectronics. This paper presented a new approach of nano element impedance matching and the technological constructions for impedance matching circuits are developed. According to this method it possible to match impedance of nano tubes with 12.8 kOhm with 50Ohms standard micro strip line in the large frequency range

articleTitle: Simulation of a Dispersion Managed Two-Mode Fiber-Optic Link
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper present results of simulation for the long-haul two-mode fiber-optic link. There were simulated some variants of the dispersion managed two-mode fiber-optic links. There were considered effect of chromatic dispersion compensation in line optical amlifiers depending of optical cable line length between neighboring amplifiers. Effect of chromatic dispersion compensation in line optical amlifiers with taking into account degree of compensation were investigated. The under-compensation and overcompensation of chromatic dispersion on a line optical amplifiers with post-compensation at recieve on far end of fiber-optic link were simulated. There were simulated the chromatic dispersion compensation on dense maps when compensation modules are set in closure on jointing of optical cables with selected interval along sections of amplification. Results of simulation are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Simulation-Based Prediction of 100-μm-Core Multimode Optical Fiber Bandwidth for 10GBase-LX Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This work is concerned with application of earlier on developed an alternative method for simulation of piecewise regular multimode fiber optic links operating in a few-mode regime for computation of laser-excited optical pulse dynamics during its propagation over irregular silica graded-index multimode optical fibers (MMFs) with extremely large core diameter. Proposed model is based on the piecewise regular representation, and it takes into account launching conditions, differential mode delay, both lower- and higher-order mode chromatic dispersion, differential mode attenuation, mode mixing and power diffusion occurring due to real fiber irregularity and micro- and macro-bends. We present some results of simulation 10GBase-LX optical signal transmission over 100-μm-core MMFs graded-index refractive index profile corresponding to the typical laser-optimized MMFs 50/125 of ISO/IEC Cat. OM2+/OM3 scaled up to 100 μm core.

articleTitle: Stability Criterion of Complex Polynomials in Markov’s Parameters and its’ Application at Selective System’s Design by the D-fragmentation Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The simple proof of the stability criterion and roof localization of complex polynomials is given in Markov's parameters. A proof bases on twice reduction of the Hermite-Hurwitz matrix order at introduction of Markov's parameters. In contrast to a criterion for complex polynomials, its real analogue - the Markov's criterion - is known from mathematical publications, but it does not practically use in engineering applications. Meanwhile, at high orders of polynomials (n>6), both criteria are preferable compared to Hurwitz and Hermite-Hurwitz criteria owing to the lower order of its matrices. This criterion is applied for stability areas investigation and for the parameter choice of selective radio-electronic devices by the modified D-fragmentation methods, in particular, multi-stage tuned amplifiers on CMOS structures and the three-stage oscillator with the stabilizing resonator. In addition, the problem of comparing the efficiency of the Hermite-Hurwitz criterion with a Markov-type criterion is being solved, and several new effective methods for constructing D-fragmentation diagrams are proposed.

articleTitle: The Use Of Synthetic Data For Training The Neural Network To Classify The Aircrafts
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes a method to generate training data for the neural network used in aircrafts' classification, localization and parameters' estimation problem. The standard description of the approach used, top-level algorithms and their configuration details provided. The simplified problem described, modeled and solved; results also included.

articleTitle: A Numerical Method for Potential Capacity Estimating of Communication Channel with Memory and Cyclo Stationary PSK-N-Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents the methodological aspects of numerical method for capacity estimating for channels with memory caused by its frequency selectivity, when a multipositional phase shift keyed signal is used as a signal. The capacity estimations were made for such communication channels with the most common amplitude-frequency responses. The effects on capacity of such adverse factors as frequency detuning and measurement errors of the phase, as well as the effect of the squelch subsystem presented in the receiver, are estimated.

articleTitle: Models of Risk of Attack of university Infocommunication System
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper deals with the features of the formation and characteristics of University data that may be subject to cyber attacks; the classification of University information; identified threats to information security of University information and ways of their leakage. Introduced a formalized definition of the mechanism of protection of University data and the proposed model of risk of cyber attacks.

Author Keywords: threat of information security of University information
methods of protection of University databases
mechanisms of protection of structures of University databases
system of protection of University information

articleTitle: Interval Method of Traffic Analysis in Multiservice Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article analyzes queuing systems’ stationary, ordinary recurrent streams of applications. The effect of correlation between the incoming flows of requests for queue sizes is determined. The article shows that the queue formation process in systems with a batched stream is cyclic. This process is divided into two sub-cycles: active and passive. Due to cycle analysis the generalization of the well-known Khinchin-Pollaczek formula is found. This formula was applicable only for Poisson queue flows before. The determined effect of correlations on the queue’s size is shown. The article proves that the maximum value of the covariation function’s integral of the applications’ number on intervals of the application’s service fully determines the middle size of queue into primary queuing systems with established load factor.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Speaker's Identification in Communication Networks and Terminal Equipment of Onboard System
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work is dedicated to the issue of speech messages quality providing in communication networks, in particular, to study the influence of the state of functional systems of the speaker on the accuracy of his speech identification. The study allowed drawing a conclusion on quite clearly formalized correspondence between changes in speech signal parameters and disease groups that define them. Such formalization can be used to increase the identification reliability level of speech sources, and for timely and rapid diagnosis of a certain set of diseases, including their early development stage. Adequate identification of speech messages sources belongs to a common task group of ensuring effective and safe operation of automated control systems as well as access control systems. The second group of tasks, in some cases, may be associated with the first one and is caused by the need of personnel health state monitoring implementing management functions of important and challenging complex systems and processes. Also, the detection of several diseases signs at their early stages is very important task to ensure the implementation of research and production programs made by members of various expeditions teams, in particular, the crews working on board space stations. As a rule, the correspondent decision - making is usually based on the correlation analysis of speech signals, as well as on the evaluation of phonogram statistical parameters. The paper proposes and justifies the algorithm for speech source identification, in condition of a set of endogenous and exogenous factor presence, affecting its informative parameters.

articleTitle: About Cycle Stationary of APSK-N-Signals Observed on the Output of Communication Channel with Intersymbol Interference
publicationTitle: 2019 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An algorithm for determining the conditions under which the multi-position amplitude-phase manipulated signal at the output of the communication channel becomes a cyclo-stationary process is presented. The results of its use were used to estimate the resolution times and effective memory for various types of amplitude-frequency responses of the channel presented in this paper. New properties were revealed for channels with ISI.
